summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second quarter 2026 earnings release and presentation. The filing reports revenue of $584 million, income from continuing operations of $56 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $286 million, along with a declared quarterly dividend of $0.23 per share payable September 1, 2026. The document contains routine quarterly results and dividend declaration, with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. The CEO and CFO commentary covers operational performance, cost savings targets, and capital allocation, but no transformative corporate action is announced.
